images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 widescreen raster game UI concept for the JOIN GAME screen of 虛擬台麻館. Image 1 is the primary reference for exact visual style, proportions, ornate gold frame grammar, typography and warm Taiwanese nighttime mahjong parlor. Image 2 is the exact 月華 identity; image 3 is 糖糖; image 4 is 小春; image 5 is 蘭姐. Preserve all six distinct existing identities from image 1: 小翠 (green twin tails, pink bows, teal sailor outfit), 月華 (long silver hair, violet eyes, crescent clip, dark blouse), 阿明 (spiky black hair, red headband, orange jacket), 糖糖 (pink twin buns, gold star clip, pink blouse), 小春 (orange ponytail, white ribbon, blue sports polo), 蘭姐 (purple updo, gold glasses, burgundy qipao). Match a high-quality 1990s Japanese cel anime game illustration with hand-painted rich Taiwanese parlor background, deep jade panels, burgundy secondary buttons, restrained antique gold borders, warm amber pendant lamp, polished wooden chairs, green mahjong table, blue-white tea cups and rainy neon outside. Crisp usable polished game UI, not a website and no browser chrome. Layout: left half is a generous jade panel, right half is a beautiful large illustration of 月華 elegantly welcoming the player to the table; the illustration has no extra interface except a small bottom dialogue box labelled 月華 with text 「今晚也來摸幾圈吧。」. Compact brand at top of left panel with exact Traditional Chinese 「虛擬台麻館」 and full English subtitle exactly 「Virtual Taiwan Mahjong Parlor」. Small top-left return button 「返回標題」. Main heading exactly 「加入牌局」. All UI text must use Traditional Chinese with accurate legible characters. Left panel in visual order: label 「玩家名稱」 and long input containing 「悠太翼」; label 「選擇角色」 and six equal portrait cards in 3 columns × 2 rows, names 小翠, 月華, 阿明 then 糖糖, 小春, 蘭姐; selected 月華 portrait has luminous gold border and tiny gold diamond. Below portraits: label 「房間地址」 and a long single input containing exactly 「192.168.1.10:7777」. Small explanatory line 「輸入房主提供的 IP 與通訊埠。」. Bottom actions are a medium burgundy secondary button 「觀戰」 and a wider luminous gold primary button 「加入牌局」 with a mahjong tile accent. Keep the return-to-title button separate. Bottom-left small appearance tabs 「90 年代」, 「PC-98」, 「MS-DOS」; 90 年代 selected. Small audio icon bottom-right. Maintain clean alignment, enough breathing space and high text contrast; ornate details restrained around the edges. No other buttons, no invented mechanics, no duplicate fields, no English placeholder text, no ready system. The address must remain complete IP:port. Output a single coherent finished screen, landscape 16:9.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 finished game UI concept for the GUEST WAITING LOBBY of 虛擬台麻館. Input image 1 is the exact host lobby reference: preserve this established UI art direction, gold border grammar, warm nighttime Taiwanese mahjong parlor background, table viewpoint, top compact brand header, two-column screen, and visual density. Input images 2, 3, 4 are exact identity references for 小翠, 月華, 阿明. This is a NEW GUEST VIEW variant of that lobby, with only guest permissions. 1990s hand-painted cel anime illustration, deep jade glasslike textured panels, antique gold fine ornaments, burgundy secondary controls, warm amber overhead lamp, wet neon street outside, polished dark wooden mahjong table and chairs, tea cups. Crisp accurate Traditional Chinese, generous clarity and premium finish. Top-left compact brand exactly 「虛擬台麻館」 with full subtitle exactly 「Virtual Taiwan Mahjong Parlor」. Top center heading exactly 「房間大廳」. Top-right burgundy leave button 「離開房間」. Left 70 percent main scenic panel: visible central green mahjong table with four discrete seat cards arranged around the table. Header 「入席玩家」 with badge 「3 / 4 已入席」. EXACTLY THREE occupied cards and EXACTLY ONE empty card. Upper-left card: 小翠 portrait, player name 「悠太翼」, gold badge 「房主」, green status 「在線」, NO action button. Upper-right card: 阿明 portrait, player name 「阿明」, blue badge 「電腦」, green status 「已入席」, NO action button. Lower-left card: 月華 portrait, player name 「小月」, clear small jade/gold badge 「你」, green status 「在線」, and exactly one small button 「更換角色」 belonging only to this card; this is the current guest player. Lower-right card: elegant empty chair silhouette with text 「等待入席」, with NO button. Keep table center visible and hands of the character portraits uncluttered. Right 30 percent sidebar: upper read-only connection panel title 「連線資訊」, address 「192.168.1.10:7777」 with a compact 「複製」 button, and green connected indicator 「已連線」. Lower chat panel titled 「牌桌聊天」 with readable messages 「[系統] 小月已入席。」 and 「悠太翼：再等一位就開始！」 and 「小月：大家晚安！」, an input placeholder 「說點什麼…」 and small send-arrow button. Bottom horizontal strip on left beneath main panel is READ-ONLY game rules: title 「本局規則」 followed by 「底 100」, 「每台 20」, 「東風圈」, 「出牌 90 秒」. There must be NO adjust-rules button. At bottom-right beneath sidebar, instead of a start button, place a prominent noninteractive dark jade status plaque with gold text exactly 「等待房主開始遊戲…」 and a small subtle waiting indicator. It must visibly look like a status message, not a bright actionable button. Bottom-left small appearance tabs 「90 年代」, 「PC-98」, 「MS-DOS」 with first selected; tiny sound icon at far bottom-right. Critical guest permissions: absolutely NO 「開始遊戲」 button, NO 「加入電腦」 buttons, NO 「移除」 buttons, NO 「調整規則」 button, NO AI management tab, NO ready mechanic or ready button. Only appearance selectors, copy address, guest's own change character, chat send, and leave room are actionable. Do not accidentally retain host controls from reference. Preserve exact character identities: 小翠 green twin tails and pink bows with sailor outfit, 月華 long silver hair violet eyes golden crescent clip dark blouse, 阿明 spiky black hair red headband orange jacket. No browser chrome, no website navigation, no duplicate seats, no six-seat table, no extra unrequested UI.
